mobile_prose_regression.initial_reader_failure: An earlier final-output parallel run observed 330 > 320. Standalone diagnostics initially did not reproduce it; broader repaired-badge coverage revealed the deterministic unbroken-prose case.

preview_server_investigation.observation: Parallel reader diagnostics reproduced net::ERR_CONNECTION_RESET for local CSS resources; computed inline-code overflow-wrap was normal because the stylesheet was unavailable. Two animation frames did not repair missing CSS.
preview_server_investigation.resolution: Temporary ThreadingHTTPServer backlog increased to 128. All four final browser suites passed concurrently without changing production CSS or weakening assertions.
